verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of a built-in AI capability is a single marketing line on Forter's homepage introducing a 'team of Forter Agents' that save the user time. That suggests in-product agents users can delegate work to, but nothing documents how users interact with them or what tasks they handle. The MCP server is not credited here: it lets an external AI client such as Claude Desktop act on Forter, which is a separate MCP-server capability, not a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: documentation of an in-product assistant interface, the specific tasks that can be delegated, how delegation works or what controls it has, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Meet your new team of Forter Agents, so you can spend more time on what matters most.
